name: saga-pack1-consumer-example
description: A synthetic notes application used to qualify the packed SDK artifacts (PACK1, REACT1). It exists as three consumers built from one contract, server, set of actions and controller: main-own.ts (Lit, the application's own catalog alone), main-card.ts (Lit, adding the optional FaithfulCard) and main-react.tsx (React, the application's own catalog alone). It is not part of the npm workspace: scripts/build-pack1-consumers.ts installs the packed SDK packages into a clean copy of it and builds that.
